notes: Route: https://www.tanjug.rs/rss (status 200; robots.txt is 200 and fully permissive, only Sitemap line is /sitemap/news.xml). That page lists 45 per-section RSS feeds at /rss/<section>; fetching /rss/<section> directly returns raw RSS XML with up to 1000 <item> entries (link + pubDate in Serbian local time, +0100/+0200). Each section feed reaches back several weeks (srbija to 2026-10-06, sport to 2026-09-18, svet to 2026-10-13, etc.), so the UNION of all 45 feeds covers the full 2026-09-25..2026-10-25 window. Listed date = pubDate date (Serbia local), which exactly equals the page JSON-LD datePublished on 4/4 spot checks (e.g. 287146 -> 2026-10-06, 291863 -> 2026-10-22, 285563 -> 2026-10-01, 284310 -> 2026-09-26); all 4 sample pages returned 200 with 10.5K-14.6K chars of text. AVOID: /sitemap/news.xml (200 but only ~374 entries covering 2026-10-24..26, and ?start= pagination does not work); /sitemap.xml, /sitemap/ and /arhiva variants all 404; /search has no date filter. Result: 7506 unique URLs, 31/31 days, per-day min 130 (09-30=221, 10-10=211, 10-20=257). ~46 requests, ran in ~1 min.
